selection: Minimum 2022 rolling MAE; first candidate wins ties
protocol: One week ahead; fit all completed history at first origin each month; update level/trend after every observation
primary: 2023-01-02 through 2023-12-31, 52 weeks, same original source snapshot
sensitivity: Same predictions excluding December 25–31, flagged before any smoothing results were computed
status: Exploratory: 2023 outcomes already examined in prior experiments
seasonality: None: limited annual repetitions, no new seasonal search
